A '''member''' of the [[Akwin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] once had his [[Hologram/Legends|holoimage]] taken by a [[Unidentified trader (Lazerian IV)|trader]]. After noticing his holoimage was taken, he and five other Akwin harassed the trader while disguised in [[Robe/Legends|robes]], stealing the image from him.

==Biography==
An [[Akwin]] was present on an island off the coast of the continent [[Laz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]<ref name="TSoK" /> following the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|formation]] of the [[New Republic]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TSoKDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|declaration]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. As the New Republic is described as being an active faction in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the adventure ideas for Lazerian IV in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], they must occur after the New Republic's formation during or after 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> While he was on the island, a [[Unidentified trader (Lazerian IV)|trader]] managed to take a [[Hologram/Legends|holoimage]] of him and left to go to a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] to tell others about what he believed to be a [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] monster. Unbeknownst to the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]], the Akwin had noticed him take the picture and returned to the sea to inform other Akwin of the event. Despite the trader's attempt to tell others of his experience, most disregarded his claims as nonsense.<ref name="TSoK" />

{{RPGseed}}
However, a group of travelers in the bar did believe the trader and bought him [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]], over which he told them the location where he took the image. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified marine biologist|marine biologist]] was also intrigued by the Akwin's existence and went to the island to investigate. Meanwhile, the Akwin had gathered five others of his kind, and they harassed the trader as he left the bar, dressed in [[Robe/Legends|robes]] to conceal themselves. The travelers intervened, attempting to protect the trader, but they were subdued by the Akwin, who made sure to refrain from injuring anyone involved in the scuffle. The Akwin proceeded to successfully escape with the holoimage. Soon after, the travelers went to the island where the first Akwin had been spotted only to encounter more Akwin, who confronted their uninvited guests.<ref name="TSoK" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Akwin was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
